title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data.

translated_title: V-LUMEN：用于视觉-语言模型嵌入扩展的视觉查找记忆
translated_abstract: 嵌入层面的扩展通过基于查找的记忆来扩展语言模型的容量，而非通过增加模型的深度、宽度或密集计算。将这一思想扩展到视觉-语言模型（VLM）具有挑战性，因为视觉特征是连续的、具有空间结构的、且依赖于查询的，这与天然支持n-gram查找的离散文本标记不同。我们提出了V-LUMEN，一种面向视觉-语言模型的视觉查找记忆。V-LUMEN使用冻结的码本对视觉特征进行离散化，通过基于空间聚合的哈希构建空间感知的记忆键，并使用文本条件化的相关性信号对其进行调制；所有寻址过程都是非参数化的，检索到的嵌入通过门控残差通路融合到主干网络中。在五个推理密集型基准测试上，V-LUMEN显著提升了冻结的Qwen3-VL-2B主干网络的性能，并能零样本迁移到三个图像与训练数据完全不相交的基准测试上。
tldr: V-LUMEN提出了一种视觉查找记忆机制，通过冻结码本离散化视觉特征、空间聚合哈希构建记忆键并结合文本条件调制信号，以完全非参数化的寻址方式为视觉-语言模型实现嵌入层面的扩展，显著提升冻结主干网络在推理基准上的表现并具备零样本迁移能力。
en_tdlr: V-LUMEN introduces a non-parametric visual lookup memory for vision-language models that discretizes visual features via a frozen codebook, builds spatially-aware memory keys through spatial aggregation hashing, and fuses retrieved embeddings via gated residual pathways, substantially improving frozen VLM backbones on reasoning benchmarks with zero-shot transfer capability.
